social.hook: The orange star on Orion’s shoulder is dying — and when Betelgeuse explodes, it will shine as brightly as the half-Moon for months.
social.question: If Betelgeuse went supernova in our lifetime, where would you go to watch it?
social.alt: ESO VLT/SPHERE view of the red supergiant Betelgeuse beside the First Quarter Moon with the caption BRIGHT AS MOON.
